recommendation: Reject this fixed-window MU transport-parity hypothesis. Do not route or promote MU, do not repair or shrink the failed window, and do not repeat the same experiment under new bounds.

diagnosis.economic_interpretation: No profitability inference is permitted. All six eligible decisions were short, no long decision was eligible, and the parity chain was correctly withheld after the source-identity failure.

decision.reason: The immutable fixed window failed its frozen-generator contract and also lacked complete, resolved observer coverage. Repeating the same hypothesis under new bounds would create serial-selection bias rather than repair this result.
decision.reopen_condition: Do not reopen this fixed transport-parity hypothesis. A future MU investigation must be a materially new preregistered hypothesis with a deployment-frozen end-to-end source contract, complete prospective coverage, both sides represented, exact executable lifecycle evidence, realistic costs, and no reuse of this failed window as success evidence.
